entries.title: OpenCode Go joins your subscriptions
entries.body: You can now add an OpenCode Go subscription: paste the key from the OpenCode Console and your first mate and crew can work on its models. Kimi K3, Grok 4.7, GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 start in your levels, and the account's row shows how much of its 5-hour, weekly and monthly allowance is left. A key set on your computer for other tools never signs an account in on its own.

picture.alt: An OpenCode Go account row in AI subscriptions, with its session, weekly and monthly meters.
